result.rationale: The diff shows RetrieveTopic (app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb) sets no sidekiq_options, while the sibling new job PollFeed explicitly sets 'sidekiq_options retry: false'. Under Sidekiq's default retry policy, an exception in retrieve (e.g., open(url) failing in TopicEmbed.import_remote) is retried many times, re-fetching the same URL — the Redis 60-second throttle in TopicRetriever would not persist across job retries/hosts indefinitely. This is a substantive, diff-grounded reliability/operational concern rather than a demonstrable correctness defect, since retrying transient fetch failures

adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Jobs::PollFeed` explicitly sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, but the newly added `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` (app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb) does not set any `sidekiq_options`. Its `execute` method can raise (e.g., `Discourse::InvalidParameters` when `embed_url` missing, and `TopicRetriever#retrieve` ultimately calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, which does `open(url).read` without rescue). With Sidekiq's default retry behavior, such failures could be retried repeatedly, potentially re-fetching a bad/poison URL. This is an operational robustness concern grounded in the added code, but not a guaranteed functional defect.
